---
title: "link-external: hand-written .external"
# bd-t3n1nghb: the link-external.scss layer is unconditional, so a
# hand-written `.external` gets its icon with no option set, and the
# transform touches nothing.
_quarto:
  tests:
    html:
      noErrorsOrWarnings: true
      ensureHtmlElements:
        - ['a.external[href="https://example.com/"]']
        - ['a[target]', 'a.external[href="https://example.org/"]']
      ensureCssRegexMatches:
        - ['a\.external:after\{']
        - []
---

[Marked by hand](https://example.com/){.external} and
[unmarked](https://example.org/).
